_comment: The capability policy: which of the portal's proposed tools reach the model, by the client's mandate and the risk screen the application wrote (R-15). A proposal the policy does not grant is reported capability_not_allowed at stage producer. transfer_funds is never granted to the assistant.

place_trade.description: Queue a market order on this client's own account for the client to confirm in the portal. Sells may not exceed the ledger's settled units.

schedule_advisor_call.description: Book a call with this client's advisor.

open_case.description: Open a service case for the fraud, disputes, access or general team.

never.transfer_funds: the assistant never moves money (fraud and disputes guideline)
